pages: {"text": "Tally of Guild crates taken: thirty-one. Good brass, rope, lamp oil, a crate of frame bolts we could not sell.\n\nThe gold-wearers came up through a gatehouse and stayed."}
{"text": "They hold the keep and we hold the walls. They want gold and we want quiet. It works.\n\nNobody goes near the gatehouses after dark. Not them, not us."}
